title: 92. How can I create my own survey themes?
intent: This article helps EUSurvey survey managers understand or perform the task: How can I create my own survey themes.
short_answer: On EUSurvey's 'Settings' page, at the top of your screen, select 'Skins' and click on 'Create a new Skin'. This will open the skin editor for survey themes. You can copy an existing theme as a basis and use the online skin editor to modify this template as necessary.
